# Daraja Copilot instructions

Before proposing or modifying code, read `docs/START-HERE.md` and `AGENTS.md` and follow the repository source of truth.

Use this workflow for every implementation task:

**Read -> Understand -> Plan -> Edit existing implementation -> Test -> Clean up -> Update docs/progress -> Hand off**

Prefer modifying or cleanly refactoring the existing owner of a behavior. Do not create `V2`, `New*`, duplicate routes/helpers/services, commented-out replacements or wrapper patches merely to avoid fixing the current implementation.
